name: SCoRE
description: SCoRE is a benchmark for evaluating long-chain commonsense reasoning in large language models through scenario-based multi-hop questions. It contains 100k bilingual multiple-choice questions with reasoning chains spanning 1 to 30 hops, annotated with fine-grained knowledge labels and difficulty levels for diagnostic evaluation.
reputation: A recent large-scale commonsense reasoning benchmark that is useful for diagnostic evaluation, though it is not yet as established as older reasoning benchmarks like CommonsenseQA or ARC.
notes: Focuses on multi-hop reasoning with up to 30 hops; includes bilingual questions and fine-grained annotations; useful for diagnostic evaluation and model training guidance.
